classification.difficultyReason: Plot horizontal or vertical intervals and average corresponding coordinates; separate x-mean, y-mean and midpoint blanks explicitly scaffold the method.

content.prompt: Sketch the line interval and calculate the midpoint.

spec.answerVisibility: Always visible; student draws the interval.
